_about: Hand-edited settings of the new rank engine (ranking-1). tools/rank/build-bench.js combines this file with data/rank/sources/* into data/rank/benchmarks.v1.json and js/data/rank-bench.js. Change a number here, run the build, and the engine follows: no app code changes.

ranks._about: The 15 levels. from = the score (0-100, a percentile of regular gym-goers who train that exercise) where the level starts. Median gym-goer (50) is Silver III. Shape from the brief, section 2b.

scoring._about: score = wBest x the better of the two percentiles (volume, max load) + (1 - wBest) x (wVolume x volume percentile + wLoad x max-load percentile). wBest 1 = the rank follows your stronger side, so heavy low-rep lifters and higher-rep lifters are both represented (Petros, 16 Nov 2026). wBest 0 = the plain weighted mix of the first draft. Coherence rules from the brief, section 2b.

conversion._about: ASSUMPTION, not data. GymStreak publishes each lifter's best set of 1-10 reps as weight x (1 + reps/30). No open source publishes the heaviest weight or the best single-set volume directly, so the two reference values are that same published figure turned back into a real set: the max-load reference is the weight of a set of 6 reps (the low end of the common 6-8 rep range), the volume reference is a set of 8 reps (the 25th-percentile rep count on squat and overhead press, 7 on bench and deadlift; chosen so the common 6-8 rep range is measured accurately). Reps above repCap add no volume. Replace with measured values when in-app data exists.

variants._about: Variation factors (brief: Variation factors). thresholds of the variation = thresholds of the anchor x factor. Sourced factors only; same family and equipment type unless the source compares exactly these two; no chains. A sex missing from factor = no rank for that sex.

smith_squat.source: Tsoukos A, Bogdanis GC. Effects of Transducer Placement on Load-Velocity Relationships in Smith Machine and Free Weight Squats in Trained Women. J Funct Morphol Kinesiol. 2025;10(2):178. doi:10.3390/jfmk10020178 (CC BY 4.0)
smith_squat.evidence: Tested 1RM, full back squat, same 11 trained women: Smith machine 92.9 +/- 16.2 kg, free weight 85.1 +/- 14.5 kg. Ratio 92.9 / 85.1 = 1.092.
smith_squat.notes: Women only: no comparable open figure for men was found, so men get no rank. Different equipment type from the anchor, allowed here because the source compares exactly these two lifts. One small study: low confidence.
